newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat sees deal with Israel by Tuesday -lawmakers.
newsitem.headline: Arafat sees deal with Israel by Tuesday -lawmakers.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat expects a Hebron deal with Israel to be signed on December 30 or 31, Palestinian legislators said on Thursday.
The officials, who declined to be identified, said Arafat announced the dates while briefing Palestinian lawmakers in Ramallah on progress in talks with Israel.
"President Arafat informed us that the PLO and Israeli negotiators are putting the final touches on the Hebron agreement...The deal will be signed either on December 30 or 31," one legislator said.
The remarks, confirmed by other lawmakers, reinforced the forecast of a senior Israeli official who told reporters on Tuesday night he expected a deal by the end of the year.
A summit on Tuesday between Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ended weeks of deadlock in talks on Israel's long overdue handover of 80 percent of Hebron to Palestinians.

Netanyahu wants security guarantees for the 400 Israeli settlers in the heart of the West Bank town of 100,000 Arabs. Hebron is a flashpoint of violence, a city holy to Jews and Moslems as the burial place of the biblical Abraham.
